title: Accept UPI Payments for Digital Products with Razorpay
seoTitle: Accept UPI Payments for Digital Products with Razorpay
description: Understand the steps involved in setting up Razorpay to accept UPI and other online payments in India.
primaryKeyword: accept UPI payments for digital products
imageAlt: A digital product and online payment guide

blocks.text: A payment gateway can help digital-product sellers collect payments through supported methods and reconcile transactions. Razorpay is one provider businesses may consider. Availability, eligibility and charges depend on the merchant account and current provider terms.

A gateway connects checkout to methods such as UPI, cards and netbanking, reports transaction status and supports settlement to a registered bank account. It does not guarantee approval or remove refund and support responsibilities.

Prepare business information and review Razorpay's current onboarding requirements. Merchants may be asked for identity, business, PAN, bank-account and website or product information. Submit details only through the official dashboard. Never share passwords, OTPs or secret keys.

Understand fees. Charges may include a percentage of successful transactions and GST on the provider fee. Rates and promotions change. For illustration, a 2% fee plus 18% GST on that fee has an effective cost of 2.36% of transaction value; this is not a guaranteed rate.

When choosing a platform with a documented gateway connection process, review its security guidance. Keep API secrets server-side, verify payment status on the server and use authenticated webhooks where required. Never grant access based only on a browser success screen. Test failed, pending, duplicate and refunded payments.

Payment processing and digital delivery are separate systems. Deliver paid files only after payment verification, use appropriate access controls and reconcile order records with provider reports. Review official pricing, prohibited-business rules, settlement timelines and refund procedures before launch.
Is UPI always free for merchants?
Do not assume every gateway service is free; check provider terms.
No. It is an illustration; actual pricing can differ.
Does connecting Razorpay deliver files automatically?
No. Payment verification and digital delivery are separate systems.
